text:
If you’re stepping out for lunch or an afternoon walk, the chill is easing, but this is still a light-jacket kind of day. Burlington is clear and sitting at 59, with sunshine pushing us toward a high near 66 and a gentle north breeze. The lake is calm enough for an easy outing, with waves a foot or less, though the water itself is only 63.

That sunshine holds through the evening, with a clear, quiet night and temperatures falling to around 43. Frost is possible in the coldest spots by Thursday morning. Tomorrow looks like a near repeat, sunny and seasonable with a high around 67, light northeast winds, and no rain in sight. Enjoy the afternoon outdoors, but bring a layer for sunset and don’t leave tender plants uncovered tonight.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST (regional station — Burlington relevance only, never their branding): BURLINGTON, Vt. (WCAX) - Happy Wednesday! It was once again a cool start to our Wednesday morning with most places starting off in the 30s and lower 40s. But we’ll have plenty of sunshine through the day ahead which means we’ll see temperatures warm up a lot closer to where we should be for this time of year. Under mostly sunny skies this afternoon, high temperatures for the day head back into the mid and upper 60s. Clear skies tonight, though, will once again mean a cool and frosty night for some as lows dip into the 30s to about 40 by early Thursday morning.
